shortDescription: Kenya's inflation (KECPI=ECI) rose to 6.6% year-on-year in August from 6.5% in July, the statistics office said on Monday.On a monthly basis, inflation was 0.4% from 0.2% in July, the Kenya National Bureau of Statistics said.

children: Kenya's inflation (KECPI=ECI) rose to 6.6% year-on-year in August from 6.5% in July, the statistics office said on Monday.
On a monthly basis, inflation was 0.4% from 0.2% in July, the Kenya National Bureau of Statistics said.
